main_text.p: σῆς λογιοτητῷ. ὥσπερ τῆς πλεονεξίας χρέος τὴν [?] δυναμένων. καὶ γὰρ τὸ δημοσιένδον[?], δὲ χρημάτων, καὶ αὐτὸ τούτων ὑδὲν ἔχει χρείας τὴν λόγων, ταῦτα [?] ἐξ τὰς πολλὰς ἡμῖν χρείας, καὶ τέλη, ἃ καὶ ἔτης ὑπομνύμεν τοῖς ἐνταῦθα κεχρῆσθαι. Indigentes autem nos præsidio pecuniario, tale aliquid petimus, Magnifico D. Cancellario, & tua humanitate intercedentibus, à munifica manu eorum, qui potentia istic valent. Nam vt Demosthenes ait, opus est pecunijs, neq; absq; his quicquam confici potest, petimus autem propter magnas necessitates nostras, & tributa, quæ quotannis pendimus his, qui apud nos dominantur. Egestatem illius extremam debuccinat Crusius ibidem. Ioannes Zygomala, si quando cum D. Gerlachio aliquo iret, aut navigaret, dicebat monstrato marsupio, ἀδωνᾶ[?]. Tunc ipse pro ipso persoluebat. Et ego mendiculo, & miserrimo credam, & potissimum in religionis negotio P.Non patitur id Dio Chrysostomus Oratione Troica; Τὰς γὰρ νῦν πτωχείας ἐδεῖν[?], φασὶν, ὑγιῶς λέγειν[?], ἐὰν μάρτυρες ἐδὲν ἀπ' ἐκείνων ποιήσωνται[?] ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ἐὰν δὲ[?] ἐπαίνης ἔχων παρ' αὐτῶν ἀποδίδοντας ὡς ἀληθῶς. ἴσασι γὰρ ὅτι πάντες ἰσχύοντες ὑπ' ἀνάγκης λέγοντες. Sane mendicos, qui nunc viuunt, nihil sani ferunt dicere, neque vllus illorum quempiam testem aliquo in re adhibuerit, neque laudes ab illis profectas accipiunt vt veras. Norunt

page.notes: Greek passages are the least certain part of this page: many words are printed faintly or broken, and the Greek letters given above are best readings and need checking against the scan. "P.Non" before "Non patitur" may be a paragraph or section mark rather than a letter; not confirmed. The left edge of the scan shows dark marks from the neighbouring page and was not transcribed. The word "enim" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
